# [Implementation] - The REVIEW verdict channel is ungoverned: one contract, a non-bypassable Tier 1, and a read that never aborts

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #297 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Precondition: `npm run build` has run (the gate above does this first), so `./dist` matches
`src`. Each check is self-contained and exits non-zero on failure. Checks that mutate pipeline
state run inside the sanctioned sandbox `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-297-*`, never in the
worktree. `dist/` is untracked — never commit it.

#### Check 1 — A bypass payload survives the parser

```bash
node -e '
const { AiReviewReport } = require("./dist/domain");
const payload = JSON.stringify({
  bypassed: true,
  diagnosticMessage: "GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.",
  summary: "AI review was bypassed: Error: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.",
  confidenceLevel: "Low",
  confidenceExplanation: "bypassed",
  comments: []
});
const report = AiReviewReport.parse(payload);
if (report.bypassed !== true) {
  console.error("S1 FAIL: parse() dropped bypassed");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (report.diagnosticMessage !== "GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.") {
  console.error("S1 FAIL: parse() dropped diagnosticMessage");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (report.isPassing() !== false) {
  console.error("S1 FAIL: a bypassed report must not pass");
  process.exit(1);
}
const coerced = AiReviewReport.parse(JSON.stringify({ summary: "x", comments: [], bypassed: "true" }));
if (coerced.bypassed !== false) {
  console.error("S1 FAIL: a truthy string must not set bypassed");
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S1 PASS: bypassed + diagnosticMessage parsed; string coercion refused");
'
```

#### Check 2 — The REVIEW payload states one contract

```bash
node -e '
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require("./dist/application");
const { DEFAULT_CONFIG } = require("./dist/infrastructure");
const { STATE_MUTATING_COMMANDS } = require("./dist/domain");
const configRepo = {
  loadConfig: () => DEFAULT_CONFIG,
  resolveModel: (role) => ({ role, configured: "flash", tier: "flash", apiModel: "gemini-2.5-flash" }),
  mapModelToTier: () => "flash"
};
const prompt = new ResolveSubagentUseCase(configRepo).buildReviewerTaskPrompt({
  issueNumber: 297,
  workspaceDir: process.cwd()
});
if (!/Never attempt to write or edit files/.test(prompt)) {
  console.error("S2 FAIL: the read-only whitelist is gone");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (/codeloop\s+review/.test(prompt)) {
  console.error("S2 FAIL: the read-only reviewer is still told to file its own verdict");
  process.exit(1);
}
const named = STATE_MUTATING_COMMANDS
  .filter((command) => command !== null)
  .filter((command) => new RegExp("codeloop\\s+" + command + "\\b").test(prompt));
if (named.length > 0) {
  console.error("S2 FAIL: the payload names mutating command(s): " + named.join(", "));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!/the orchestrator files it/.test(prompt)) {
  console.error("S2 FAIL: the payload does not say who files the block");
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S2 PASS: read-only reviewer, zero mutating commands, orchestrator named as the filer");
'
```

#### Check 3 — A subagent cannot file; the orchestrator can

```bash
REPO="$(pwd)"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-297-guard"
rm -rf "$SB"
mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const dir = process.argv[1];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, ".agyloop", "tasks", "50.json"), JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "REVIEW", mode: "standard", issue: 50, baseBranch: "main",
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, history: [{ stage: "REVIEW", timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, reviewDispatchCount: 0
}));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "verdict.md"),
  "REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: reviewer emits the block\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- None\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- None\n");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "critique-clean.json"), JSON.stringify({
  summary: "Clean automated review", confidenceLevel: "High",
  confidenceExplanation: "diff verified", comments: []
}));
' "$SB"
cd "$SB"
AGY_SUBAGENT=1 env -u NODE_ENV -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" review --issue 50 --verdict-file verdict.md --critique-report critique-clean.json > "$SB/marked.log" 2>&1
MARKED=$?
if [ "$MARKED" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "S3 FAIL: a subagent-marked review succeeded"
  cat "$SB/marked.log"
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "Subagents are not permitted" "$SB/marked.log"; then
  echo "S3 FAIL: the failure was not the root-mutation guard"
  cat "$SB/marked.log"
  exit 1
fi
node -e '
const state = require(process.argv[1]);
if (state.currentStage !== "REVIEW") {
  console.error("S3 FAIL: a refused filing still moved the checkpoint to " + state.currentStage);
  process.exit(1);
}
' "$SB/.agyloop/tasks/50.json"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT -u NODE_ENV -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" review --issue 50 --verdict-file verdict.md --critique-report critique-clean.json > "$SB/open.log" 2>&1
OPEN=$?
if [ "$OPEN" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "S3 FAIL: the orchestrator invocation was refused"
  cat "$SB/open.log"
  exit 1
fi
node -e '
const state = require(process.argv[1]);
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
if (state.currentStage !== "COMMIT") {
  console.error("S3 FAIL: the orchestrator filing did not advance to COMMIT");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (last.metadata.reviewSource !== "reviewer-output") {
  console.error("S3 FAIL: reviewSource is " + String(last.metadata.reviewSource));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (last.metadata.reviewerVerdict !== "APPROVED" || last.metadata.reviewVerdict !== "APPROVED") {
  console.error("S3 FAIL: the reviewer own status was not recorded");
  process.exit(1);
}
' "$SB/.agyloop/tasks/50.json"
echo "S3 PASS: subagent refused, orchestrator filed, reviewerVerdict + reviewSource recorded"
```

#### Check 4 — A supplied verdict cannot outrank Tier 1

```bash
REPO="$(pwd)"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-297-tier1"
rm -rf "$SB"
mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const dir = process.argv[1];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, ".agyloop", "tasks", "50.json"), JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "REVIEW", mode: "standard", issue: 50, baseBranch: "main",
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, history: [{ stage: "REVIEW", timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, reviewDispatchCount: 0
}));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "verdict.md"),
  "REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: self approval\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- None\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- None\n");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "critique.json"), JSON.stringify({
  summary: "Automated critique found a blocking defect",
  confidenceLevel: "High",
  confidenceExplanation: "static scan",
  comments: [{
    path: "src/index.ts", line: 1, rule: "blocking-defect",
    message: "Forged blocking defect", severity: "error"
  }]
}));
' "$SB"
cd "$SB"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT -u NODE_ENV -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" review --issue 50 --verdict-file verdict.md --critique-report critique.json > "$SB/run.log" 2>&1
CODE=$?
if [ "$CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "S4 FAIL: an APPROVED FILED beside an error finding exited 0"
  cat "$SB/run.log"
  exit 1
fi
grep -q "CHANGES_REQUESTED" "$SB/run.log" || { echo "S4 FAIL: CHANGES_REQUESTED not reported"; cat "$SB/run.log"; exit 1; }
node -e '
const state = require(process.argv[1]);
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
const metadata = last.metadata;
if (state.currentStage !== "IMPLEMENT") {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: stage is " + state.currentStage);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.reviewVerdict !== "CHANGES_REQUESTED") {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: reviewVerdict is " + String(metadata.reviewVerdict));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.reviewSource !== "reviewer-output+critique-escalation") {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: reviewSource is " + String(metadata.reviewSource));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.reviewerVerdict !== "APPROVED") {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: the reviewer own status was not preserved");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.critiqueVerified !== true) {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: critiqueVerified is " + String(metadata.critiqueVerified));
  process.exit(1);
}
' "$SB/.agyloop/tasks/50.json"
echo "S4 PASS: Tier 1 escalated a filed APPROVED; reviewerVerdict + source + critiqueVerified recorded"
```

#### Check 5 — A review that did not run is SKIPPED, never a rejection

```bash
REPO="$(pwd)"
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-297-skipped"
rm -rf "$SB"
mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const dir = process.argv[1];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, ".agyloop", "tasks", "50.json"), JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "REVIEW", mode: "standard", issue: 50, baseBranch: "main",
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, history: [{ stage: "REVIEW", timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, reviewDispatchCount: 0
}));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "bypass.json"), JSON.stringify({
  bypassed: true,
  diagnosticMessage: "GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.",
  summary: "AI review was bypassed: Error: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.",
  confidenceLevel: "Low",
  confidenceExplanation: "bypassed",
  comments: []
}));
' "$SB"
cd "$SB"
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT -u NODE_ENV -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" review --issue 50 --critique-report bypass.json > "$SB/run.log" 2>&1
CODE=$?
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "S5 FAIL: a bypassed report was treated as a rejection (exit $CODE)"
  cat "$SB/run.log"
  exit 1
fi
grep -q "SKIPPED" "$SB/run.log" || { echo "S5 FAIL: SKIPPED not reported"; cat "$SB/run.log"; exit 1; }
node -e '
const state = require(process.argv[1]);
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
const metadata = last.metadata;
if (state.currentStage !== "COMMIT") {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: stage is " + state.currentStage + " (a bypass must not revert)");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.reviewVerdict !== "SKIPPED") {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: reviewVerdict is " + String(metadata.reviewVerdict));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.reviewSource !== "skipped") {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: reviewSource is " + String(metadata.reviewSource));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (metadata.critiqueVerified !== false) {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: critiqueVerified is " + String(metadata.critiqueVerified));
  process.exit(1);
}
if ("selfCorrectionPayload" in metadata) {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: a skipped review produced a self-correction payload");
  process.exit(1);
}
' "$SB/.agyloop/tasks/50.json"
echo "S5 PASS: bypass recorded as SKIPPED/skipped, COMMIT, no self-correction payload"
```

#### Check 6 — A REVIEW read degrades instead of aborting

```bash
REPO="$(pwd)"
SB="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agyloop-297-readprobe"
rm -rf "$SB"
mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const dir = process.argv[1];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, ".agyloop", "tasks", "50.json"), JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "REVIEW", mode: "standard", issue: 50, baseBranch: "main",
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, history: [{ stage: "REVIEW", timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, reviewDispatchCount: 0
}));
' "$SB"
cd "$SB"
env -u NODE_ENV -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 50 > "$SB/out.log" 2> "$SB/err.log"
CODE=$?
if [ "$CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "S6 FAIL: the REVIEW read aborted (exit $CODE) instead of returning the directive"
  tail -5 "$SB/err.log"
  exit 1
fi
grep -q "Invoke AI Reviewer Subagent" "$SB/out.log" || { echo "S6 FAIL: no directive on stdout"; cat "$SB/out.log"; exit 1; }
grep -q "codeloop review --issue 50 --verdict-file" "$SB/out.log" || { echo "S6 FAIL: the directive no longer names the channel"; cat "$SB/out.log"; exit 1; }
grep -q "could not record the review dispatch counter" "$SB/err.log" || { echo "S6 FAIL: the failed save was silent"; cat "$SB/err.log"; exit 1; }
echo "S6 PASS: directive returned, channel named, failed counter save reported on stderr"
```
